slides.title: Legs throw it.
slides.body: The arms only steer. If your shoulders are cooked by round two, your legs are skipping work.

slides.title: Catch it high.
slides.body: Elbows under the ball, absorb it straight into the squat. Don't catch, pause, then squat.

slides.title: Deep, then drive.
slides.body: Hips below knees, chest up. Stand up hard and fast. The ball should feel light on the way up.

slides.title: Stand tall first.
slides.body: Hips and knees open, then the arms push. Arms are the last thing to move, like a thruster with a target.

slides.title: Exhale as it leaves.
slides.body: Breathe out on the throw, in on the catch. Holding your breath is why 20 reps feel like 50.
